criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Requests regarding ordering, activating, or reporting lost, stolen, or damaged physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Card Payments & Declines
categories.definition: Issues where card transactions are declined, failing, or not working at terminals or online.

categories.name: Card Security & PIN
categories.definition: Requests to manage, reset, or unblock a PIN, or issues regarding blocked cards.

categories.name: Card Delivery Status
categories.definition: Inquiries about the shipping status, tracking, or non-arrival of a physical card.

categories.name: Transfers Out
categories.definition: Issues with sending money to others, including failed, pending, or missing outgoing transfers.

categories.name: Transfer Cancellation
categories.definition: Requests to stop or cancel an outgoing transfer that has already been initiated.

categories.name: Transfer Fees & Limits
categories.definition: Questions about the costs, limits, or operational rules for sending money.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems with adding money to the account, including failed, pending, or reverted top-ups.

categories.name: Top-Up Methods & Limits
categories.definition: Inquiries about how to add money, supported methods, and associated limits or fees.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Problems specifically related to using the card at ATMs, including capture or dispensing errors.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Fees
categories.definition: Questions or disputes regarding fees charged for using ATMs.

categories.name: Transaction Disputes & Fraud
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized transactions, fraud, or unknown charges on the account statement.

categories.name: Refunds & Reversals
categories.definition: Issues regarding the status of expected refunds or transactions that were reversed by the merchant.

categories.name: Transaction Fees
categories.definition: Questions or disputes about fees applied to specific card transactions or currency exchanges.

categories.name: Exchange Rates & Currency
categories.definition: Inquiries about exchange rates, supported currencies, or currency conversion issues.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions regarding the process of verifying identity to use the account.

categories.name: Account Access & Security
categories.definition: Problems logging in, resetting passcodes, or managing account security settings.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to change personal details, open sub-accounts, or close the account.

categories.name: Source of Funds
categories.definition: Requests to verify or explain the origin of funds appearing in the account balance.
